content.short: PVPBet is a decentralized short-term prediction market where players bet by simple transfers.
content.description: PVPBet is a decentralized betting platform focused on short-term prediction markets. Players can join a bet with a simple token transfer instead of connecting a wallet, and winnings are distributed automatically once results are settled by governance token holders. It runs on Base and World Chain and is a World App mini app.
content.meta: PVPBet is a short-term decentralized prediction market on Base and World Chain, with a World App mini app.
